name: Ganpati decoration setup for the home mandap (SpecialYou)
blurb: Ganesh Chaturthi is 14 September. A ready setup so you are not running to the market the night before. Check exactly what is in the box on the listing.

name: Dettol Sensitive liquid handwash, 1.35 litre
blurb: The one thing every house runs out of. The big size, so you buy it once a quarter instead of once a month.

name: Dettol Icy Cool body wash, pump bottle
blurb: The menthol one for September heat. A pump, so the whole family is not squeezing the last drop from a tube.

name: Himalaya Purifying Neem face wash
blurb: The face wash half of India already uses. Buy it when it is on deal, not at MRP.

name: Parachute Advansed protein shampoo with coconut
blurb: For hair that is breaking in the monsoon humidity. A brand you know, on deal, beats an unknown one at any price.

name: Pilgrim 5% Vitamin C brightening serum sunscreen
blurb: Serum and sunscreen in one step, for people who will not do two. Morning Vitamin C is the one routine dermatologists agree on.

name: Chemist At Play 10% Vitamin C serum
blurb: A higher-strength Vitamin C without sunscreen mixed in, for people who already use a separate SPF.

name: Pilgrim 10% Niacinamide face serum, 30ml, pack of 2
blurb: Niacinamide is the ingredient for oily, acne-prone skin, and the two-pack is the sensible way to buy something you use daily.

name: Pilgrim Patuá & Keratin smoothing shampoo
blurb: For frizz that the humidity brings back every morning. Keratin smoothing, from a brand that has become the default on Indian shelves.

name: MAANGE 23-piece makeup brush set
blurb: For the person who owns three brushes and uses one. Foundation, blending, eye and lip brushes in one roll.

name: Just Herbs herb-enriched lipstick kit, 8 creamy matte shades
blurb: Eight shades in one box for the price of one or two branded lipsticks. Festive season is three weeks away.

name: Carlton London Exotique perfume gift set for women
blurb: A boxed set, which makes it the easy Ganpati or Diwali gift that does not need wrapping.

name: Beco moisturising liquid handwash, Mahogany Teakwood
blurb: A handwash that does not smell of hospital.

name: Bubble Me magnesium Epsom bath salt
blurb: For the sore back after a week on a bad chair. A bucket soak with Epsom salt is the cheapest thing that actually helps.

name: Tuco Kids mild shampoo, soapnut and henna
blurb: Built on soapnut and henna, for kids whose scalp reacts to the adult stuff.

name: OZiva hair growth serum with 3% Redensyl
blurb: Redensyl is the ingredient this serum is built around; the maker publishes its own studies, so treat it as a three-month trial, not a one-week miracle.

name: Yogabar protein bar combo, 16 bars
blurb: For the 4pm office hunger that otherwise ends at the samosa counter. Multigrain and brownie in one box.

name: Yogabar Power Up 20g protein bar, 5 bars, coffee
blurb: 20 grams of protein per bar, coffee flavour. The gym-bag bar for the day you skip the shake.

name: Bertolli olive oil for Indian cooking, 1 litre
blurb: The extra-light one that takes tadka heat without smoking. If you have been meaning to switch for one pan, this is the bottle.

name: Borges extra light olive oil for Indian cooking
blurb: The other big name in cooking olive oil. Compare it with Bertolli on the day; whichever is cheaper is the right answer.

name: Bertolli extra virgin olive oil, 1 litre
blurb: For salads and drizzling, not for frying. Cold-extracted. Buy the extra-light one above for the kadhai.

name: Farmley chia seeds, 500g
blurb: The half-kilo pack, so you stop buying the 100g one every fortnight. Overnight oats, smoothies, or soaked in water.

name: Nature Prime raw pumpkin seeds 250g + sunflower seeds 250g
blurb: For salads, raita, or straight from the jar at 11pm. Two 250g packs in one order.

name: Nature Prime raw seeds combo, 1kg
blurb: Pumpkin, flax, sunflower and more in one kilo bag. The bulk buy for the household that actually eats them.

name: Nature Prime fox nuts (makhana), 1kg
blurb: The kilo bag. Roast with ghee and salt in three minutes: a fasting food, a movie snack, and a school tiffin filler.

name: Happilo plain prasadam makhana, 200g
blurb: Prasadam-grade, plain, for the puja plate this Ganpati and the roasting pan afterwards.

name: Nature Trust raw organic forest honey, 1.2kg
blurb: The big jar. Raw and unheated, for morning water and for the cough that comes with the season change.

name: End2End Vitamin C 1000mg with amla and zinc tablets
blurb: Amla-based Vitamin C with zinc for the season-change sniffles. Check the dose on the label against what your doctor suggests.

name: Bikano Bombay mixture
blurb: The namkeen for the evening chai. Buy on deal, hide from the children.

name: NutritJet stevia liquid drops, zero calorie
blurb: For the person cutting sugar from chai without giving up chai. A few drops per cup.

name: Beco natural liquid detergent, front-load, 4 litre refill
blurb: Front-load formula in the 4 litre refill, which works out far cheaper per wash than the bottle.

name: Fortune 5-in-1 dishwasher tablets, 90
blurb: Ninety washes in one box. If you own a dishwasher, this is the single consumable that matters.

name: Softouch 3-ply toilet tissue rolls
blurb: The boring one. Buy the bulk pack on deal and forget about it for two months.

name: Softovac-SF isabgol fibre plus, 450g
blurb: Sugar-free isabgol, the fibre supplement that every Indian household eventually ends up on.

name: Solimo disposable underpads (Amazon Brand)
blurb: For elderly care at home, a new baby, or a recovering patient. Amazon's own brand, which is usually the cheapest per piece.

name: Liberty Eco adult diaper pants, medium
blurb: For home care of a parent. Pant-style, medium size. Check the waist range on the listing before ordering.

name: Eveready Utsav LED pixel string lights, 33 feet, BIS-marked
blurb: BIS-marked, so not the roadside ones that die in a week. Ganpati now, Diwali next month: one purchase, two festivals.

name: Amazon Basics room-darkening blackout door curtains
blurb: For the bedroom that faces the street light or the east sun. Room-darkening, not just a dark colour.

name: BonKaso 3-way folding cloth drying stand
blurb: The monsoon problem: clothes that never dry. A stand for the balcony or a spare corner, folds flat when the sun comes back.

name: Trance cotton-feel mattress protector, queen size
blurb: The thing that makes an expensive mattress last ten years instead of five. Machine washable.

name: Wakefit waterproof terry cotton mattress protector
blurb: Waterproof, for the house with a toddler or an elderly parent. Terry cotton on top, so it does not feel like plastic.

name: Nestasia PickSip40 1.2L insulated tumbler with straw and handle
blurb: The 1.2 litre tumbler that makes you actually drink water at your desk. Insulated, with a straw, with a handle.
